config.mod_edbbb538.title: Elytra Trails · Config
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.shape.name: Trail position
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.shape.tip: Where the trail appears: central streamer, wing-tip lines, or both.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.style.name: Trail style
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.style.tip: Color effect of the trail ribbon: Dust follows your dye color, Rainbow shifts hues automatically, other styles add matching spark particles on top.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.stardust.name: Stardust
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.stardust.tip: Scatter end-rod sparks along the trail.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.water_drops.name: Water drops
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.water_drops.tip: Bubble droplets while gliding; much more frequent in rain.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.afterimages.name: Afterimages
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.afterimages.tip: Leave a particle silhouette behind every 0.5 seconds.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.wind_sound.name: Wind sound
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.wind_sound.tip: Wind while gliding; volume and pitch follow your speed.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.rocket_sound.tip: A boom when a firework boost starts.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.smart_shedding.t: Halve the particle budget when FPS is low or particle settings are reduced.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.particle_limit.t: Max trail particles this mod may spawn per client tick; shared by all players.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.low_fps.name: Low FPS threshold
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.low_fps.tip: FPS below this triggers load shedding (requires smart load shedding).
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.mode.name: Activation mode
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.mode.tip: When trails appear: gliding, high speed, rocket boosts only, or custom.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.glide_speed.name: Glide speed threshold
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.glide_speed.tip: GLIDE mode: trail appears above this speed (blocks/s).
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.high_speed.name: High speed threshold
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.high_speed.tip: HIGH_SPEED mode: trail appears above this speed (blocks/s).
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.custom_speed.tip: Speed gate used by CUSTOM mode (blocks/s).
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.custom_requires_: CUSTOM mode also requires an active firework boost.
config.mod_edbbb538.opt.rocket_memory.ti: How long a boost still counts as active after the rocket ends (ticks).
config.mod_edbbb538.note.audio: Tip: wind volume and pitch adapt to your glide speed automatically.
config.mod_edbbb538.note.performance: The particle budget is shared by all trails; exceeding it thins trails instead of dropping frames.
config.mod_edbbb538.note.activation.mp: Connected to a server: activation is decided by the server config; shown read-only below.
config.mod_edbbb538.note.activation.unlo: Enter a world to view and adjust activation settings.
